title: `submitStrategy()` DOS
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  `Governance.submitStrategy()` is strict to have only one pending strategy per vault. Moreover, no new strategy can be accepted for voting. It can only be accepted either after accepting or rejecting a pending strategy or after 6 hours after submission.  In addition, this function is public, so anyone can submit.  As a result, the simplest attack vector is spamming any new strategy as soon as submission is available.
